_comment: We publish this, because nobody else has. There is no c:papers convention on either loader yet --
only c:dyes and friends -- so a mod with its own paper has nothing to tag it into. Declaring it the
name the convention WOULD have (Fabric pluralises item tags) means that if anyone else adopts it we
already match, and meanwhile we read it ourselves. This is what Create and Immersive Engineering did
with forge:ingots/copper years before vanilla had copper.
